source: Reply review workbook (adapted examples; fictional names and addresses)

rows.subject: Approval needed: Harbor pilot agreement
rows.email:
From: Maya Chen <maya@northstar.example>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@northstar.example>
Subject: Approval needed: Harbor pilot agreement

Hi Alex,

Harbor has accepted our revised pilot scope. The attached agreement covers six weeks at $8,400, with no automatic renewal. Can you approve it by Thursday noon so I can send it for signature?

Best,
Maya Chen
rows.why: Maya cannot send the pilot agreement until you authorize its scope and price.
rows.action: Approve the terms or identify required changes by Thursday noon.
rows.recipientContext: You approve customer contracts.

rows.subject: Saturday migration coverage: six extra hours
rows.email:
From: Eli Brooks <eli@northstar.example>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@northstar.example>

Best,
Eli Brooks

rows.action: Confirm permitted hours and payroll timing, or arrange other coverage.
rows.recipientContext: You manage Eli and approve overtime.
